defect_confirmed_before_change.reachability: EodPublicationRepository::sealProvenanceScope() returns ANALYTICAL_ONLY when the publication has no observation_manifest_hash and the run promote_mode is analytical_remediation_current (RecomputeCurrentIndicatorsCommand); assertPublicationIntegrityContextComplete() then does not require observation_manifest_hash. The upstream contract therefore permits the state rather than making it impossible.

per_input_probe_derivation: The contract states one rule for every required input and the implementation is one loop over BOUND_INPUT_FIELDS. Per-field membership is covered by the dataProvider; P2 shows that removing one field is caught by exactly that field's cases. A separate probe per field would re-test the same loop.
residual_observations_not_remediated: A null calendar/status/event revision-set member is Binding-nullable and still yields a non-empty composite hash; distinguishing an empty set from an unbound member is a Binding/composition question, not admission.
read_model_version is not in the repository direct-write check for either mode (the service admission check covers it for PUBLICATION_EXACT).
A PUBLICATION_EXACT replay with no resolved publication skips bound-context admission; its result cannot persist (REPLAY_EXPLICIT_PUBLICATION_REQUIRED).
